phase_0.domain_name: return arm frame position to scalar mapping
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.justification: Forward morphism converting vector coordinates to a scalar progress value

AREV.justification: Reverse morphism returning the arm to a safe base configuration

CLINK.justification: Composition of encoder data and solver input into a unified stream

ENGAGR.justification: Both valid geometry and invalid control held simultaneously at a singularity

EVALF.justification: Negative state where kinematics fail or exceed physical limits

EVALT.justification: Affirmative state where kinematics are solvable and within bounds

FFUSE.justification: Multiplication rejoining valid and invalid outcomes into one resolved state

FSPLIT.justification: Co-multiplication branching on pose singularity and reachability

IFIX.justification: Permanent fixation of the scalar value or error code in non-volatile memory

IMSCRIB.justification: Self-recognition of the manipulator coordinate system without transformation

TANCH.justification: Final boundary containing the mapping result and closing the loop

VINIT.justification: Initial void before kinematic data loads into the controller

phase_2.fuse_result: Single resolved status containing scalar or error code
phase_2.rejoin_note: Arms compute scalar or retract; they rejoin to a single output state for the next cycle
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) — both held at once: a live contradiction, the paraconsistent resolution
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) — neither: uninitialized, nothing established

steps.domain_action: System powers on with undefined arm state
Arm identifies its own coordinate frame
Sensor data chains to the kinematic solver
Branch on kinematic validity and singularity
Pose confirmed as solvable and within bounds
Transform pose vector to scalar progress value
Pose rejected due to collision or limit
Retract arm to safe base configuration
Singular state holds valid geometry and invalid control
Rejoin arms into single resolved status
Record scalar value or error code permanently

phase_5.alfs_store: Calibration table serving as the bootstrap store
phase_5.compiler_frontend: Kinematic solver translating geometry to commands
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: CAN bus transmitting encoder and actuator signals
phase_5.memory_mechanism: EEPROM storing calibration and log entries

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — Energy dissipated equals work done on the mapping
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Mapped scalar value stored in memory
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Idle arm with undefined target scalar
